Top-level TOML editor replaces/removes/inserts the selected key while respecting detected sections, multiline strings and comments; it is a source algorithm, not a tested TOML semantic equivalence proof.
Network editor supports dotted key and sandbox_workspace_write section, inserts if absent, and throws on an encountered inline sandbox table.
The local scanner records comment positions and multiline string state to guide TOML edits; arbitrary TOML corner-case behavior has not been executed.

Read error is treated as missing file only for Error objects whose trim().toLowerCase() message equals enoent or includes no such file/not found; other read errors are replaced by a generic project-config read failure.

No selected scope, managed scope, or null file path produces a UI lock reason; actual managed configuration is unobserved.
Control lock combines scope lock, no allowed options and imported managed-origin predicate; imported predicate semantics are outside this page.
Display approval-policy reader accepts untrusted/on-request/never/on-failure, while project writer whitelist remains the narrower on-request/never set.
Reset rejection is classified as aborted only by Error/DOMException AbortError or message containing aborted; classification alone does not prove cancellation reached the service.
Dependency child receives xe.primaryRuntime only when present; the imported value and runtime receiver identity are unknown.
Local helper appends a final newline unless input is empty or already newline-terminated.
Section detector recognizes trimmed single-bracket table headers and normalizes dots/quotes; complete TOML syntax/library ownership is not established.
Local replacement helper preserves leading whitespace and a detected trailing comment.
Generic option row disables for explicit disabled or lock reason, maps menu onSelect to its callback with option.value and renders error/lock; imported menu delivery remains unobserved.
Scope menu item forwards the supplied onSelect callback and tooltip/selected flag; external UI event delivery is unobserved.
Baseline/persistent reasoning menu item is rendered checked and disabled; user-writable max/ultra choices use the separate Gt handler.
